audit.why: Emerald+ headline is 54.13% over 1524 games and the late paragraph already cites 54%.

Level chart (Rumble 1-3, Skill 4-5, Akali 6 and first item, Rumble 2+) matches the real shape: Rumble bullies a melee pre-6, Akali's Perfect Execution plus one AP item flips the 1v1, and Rumble's teamfight ultimate reclaims value later. Difficulty 7.5/10 and carry threat 8.5/10 are consistent with a 54% Rumble-favoured lane that can still lose to one R rotation.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike names Perfect Execution but never states what makes it lethal — the second cast is an execute on missing health — and gives no cooldown, so the reader cannot time the window.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s and the recast carries the execute flag; the missing-interactions file flags exactly this (execute-threshold: track the HP number, not the health bar). Rumble's own spikes (Danger Zone chaining at 4-5, Liandry's first item, The Equalizer on 130/105/80) are otherwise correctly placed.
audit.corrected: Level-6 spike now states the execute recast and the 120s rank-1 cooldown as the punish window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup is stated backwards. Both layers claim Twilight Shroud lets Akali 'vanish the sustained damage' and that Rumble is helpless inside it ('Untargetable inside. Poke when down.', 'Fight her in the shroud' as a Don't). Twilight Shroud makes Akali invisible and unselectable by spells and attacks — it does not stop non-targeted damage. Flamespitter is a cone, Electro Harpoon is a skillshot and The Equalizer is a ground zone, so every point of Rumble's damage still lands on her inside the smoke. Also missing: Shuriken Flip marks the smoke cloud itself, which is how she re-enters, and Assassin's Mark is the auto-reset burst tell.
audit.why: Riot's own Twilight Shroud text says she becomes 'invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' — selection, not area damage. Rumble's Q/E/R are all non-selected. Shuriken Flip's description explicitly says 'the first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked'. Assassin's Mark carries the autoReset flag and rings the target on spell damage. Building the whole lane plan around 'never fight in the shroud' throws away Rumble's best window.
audit.corrected: Shroud text rewritten across both layers: unselectable, not immune — park the Flamespitter cone on the smoke. Shuriken Flip's smoke-marking re-entry and the Assassin's Mark ring tell added.

audit.whatIsWrong: early claims Twilight Shroud is 'a 25-second cooldown' and whys[2] claims it is '20+ seconds long at low rank'. Both are wrong and the second confuses duration with cooldown.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16 seconds. Shuriken Flip, the cooldown that actually gates her re-engage, is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 and is never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Real numbers substituted; Shuriken Flip's 16s rank-1 cooldown added to the cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Don'ts list 'Fight her in the shroud' as the headline mistake, which teaches the opposite of the correct play, and pairs the poke Don't with a description about burning a committal cooldown that does not match its own heading.
audit.why: The real mistakes are throwing autos at an unselectable target and missing the Assassin's Mark wind-up.
audit.corrected: Don'ts rewritten to auto-whiffing and the ring tell.

notes: The 'Untargetable inside / never fight in the shroud' line is templated boilerplate that appears verbatim in dosFull, dontsFull, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and loading. It is factually wrong for Rumble specifically, because his entire damage kit is non-selected. I corrected every instance I could reach; the 'loading' string also carries 'Engage only on Twilight Shroud's cooldown' but I left it alone since the line reads as acceptable shorthand rather than a false claim. suspectNames flagged 'Perfect Execution's' — false positive, that is the real R name.
